decision: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season.
fact: Leaving the track and rejoining unsafely at the exit of T8 at 17:28.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code.
penalty: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), the team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Albon left the circuit at Turn 8 at the end of Q1. He then rejoined the circuit on the racing line. While he was always going to have to rejoin on the line, the Stewards feel that he could have done more to ensure that he rejoined safely while another car was approaching.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Rejoining Unsafely
